name: Leather Armor
description: Tanned leather stitched into serviceable protection.

name: Linen Robe
description: Lightweight robe woven from enchanted linen.

name: Cloth Vest
description: A simple padded vest. Better than nothing.

name: Chainmail
description: Interlocked rings of iron. Heavy but reliable.

name: Ashigaru Armor
description: Lacquered foot-soldier armour, light yet protective.

name: Iron Shield
description: A heavy iron-plated shield strapped to the offhand — held alongside a weapon, not worn over the chest.

name: Rough Shield
description: A crudely bolted wooden shield, better than bare hands but not by much.

name: Guardian Shield
description: An enchanted bulwark said to have shrugged off a dragon's breath. Radiates quiet warmth.

name: Leather Vest
description: Supple leather cut for unhindered movement.

name: Fur Cloak
description: Thick pelts sewn and bound around the torso. Crude but warm and protective.

name: Shadow Cloak
description: Dark wrappings bound tight over the chest, woven to swallow light.

name: Health Potion
description: Restores 50 HP when consumed.

name: Mana Potion
description: Restores 50 MP when consumed.

name: Hi-Health Potion
description: Restores 150 HP when consumed.

name: Hi-Mana Potion
description: Restores 150 MP when consumed.

name: Normal Boots
description: Leather-soled boots with a thin iron toe cap.

name: Iron Helmet
description: A solid forged iron helmet with a reinforced brow guard.

name: Iron Chestplate
description: Thick iron plates layered over a leather backing.

name: Iron Boots
description: Reinforced iron-plated boots. Heavy but protective.

name: Diamond Helmet
description: A faceted diamond-laced helm. Near-impossible to crack.

name: Diamond Chestplate
description: Diamond-inlaid plate armour that disperses impact across its entire surface.

name: Diamond Boots
description: Lightweight boots lined with diamond dust for grip and protection.

name: Titanium Helmet
description: A flawless titanium helm — the pinnacle of conventional smithing.

name: Titanium Chestplate
description: Titanium plate so dense it absorbs damage before you even feel it.

name: Titanium Boots
description: Titanium-forged boots with articulated joints for speed without sacrifice.

name: Divine Helmet
description: A halo-edged helm said to turn aside fate itself.

name: Divine Chestplate
description: Armour forged from celestial ore at the edge of existence. Nothing passes through it.

name: Divine Boots
description: Boots that leave no footprint. Speed and protection in perfect balance.

name: Mega Health Potion
description: A dense crimson brew. Restores 400 HP when consumed.

name: Mega Mana Potion
description: A dense azure brew. Restores 400 MP when consumed.

name: Stamina Potion
description: A shimmering brew, absurdly costly to brew. Fully restores stamina when consumed.

name: Elixir
description: A shimmering draught said to be brewed from starlight. Fully restores HP and MP.

name: Ether
description: Distilled magical essence. Fully restores MP.

name: Phoenix Down
description: A single warm feather. Instantly revives a fallen ally at full HP — or fully heals one still standing. Use it before you fall, not after.

name: Antidote
description: A bitter herbal remedy. Cures poison.

name: Burn Salve
description: A cooling paste of aloe and mint. Cures burning.

name: Warm Cloth
description: A thick woolen wrap, still radiating heat. Cures freeze.

name: Severing Elixir
description: A bitter draught that knits a Reshaped wound shut. Drink it to stop the Tear's bleed. Alchemists began brewing it by the crate once Urahara made a habit of the wound.

name: Smelling Salts
description: A sharp, acrid tonic. Snaps you out of a stun instantly.

name: Clear Tonic
description: Rinses the eyes with enchanted spring water. Cures blindness.

name: Full Remedy
description: A potent all-purpose remedy. Cures every negative status effect at once.

name: Regen Herb
description: A slow-release healing root. Restores 25 HP per turn for 4 turns.

name: Warrior's Draught
description: A heady brew that surges through the arms. Boosts STR for 3 turns.

name: Swiftness Draught
description: A fizzing, sharp-smelling tonic. Boosts AGI for 3 turns.

name: Sage's Draught
description: A cold, glowing infusion. Boosts INT for 3 turns.

name: Stone Skin Draught
description: A gritty, mineral-heavy draught. Boosts DEF for 3 turns.

name: Barrier Tonic
description: Coats the body in a shimmering barrier. Absorbs up to 120 damage for 3 turns.

name: Totem of Undying
description: A carved totem humming with defiant life. Equip it in your offhand — when a killing blow would land, it shatters to save you instead, restoring a sliver of HP/MP and letting you keep all your gear. Consumed on use; re-equip a new one after it triggers.

name: Blue Band
description: A plain band of deep blue, humming faintly against the skin. Worn in the offhand it wards off the End's magical air — no weakening, no deep sleep. The old woman of Astral Town parts with one only for those who answer her honestly. It cannot be bought or sold.

name: Gambler's Relic
description: A weighted die that never quite lands the way it should. Equip it in your offhand for a permanent +25 Luck — sharper crits, better dodges, and better odds everywhere Luck matters.

name: Sentinel's Bulwark
description: A shard of a fallen guardian's shield, still humming with old wards. Equip it in your offhand for a permanent +30 Defense — mitigates more of every hit you take.

name: Arcane Battery
description: A crystal core that never fully discharges. Equip it in your offhand for a permanent +20 Intelligence and +60 Max MP — more mana to burn, harder-hitting skills.

name: Berserker's Chain
description: A broken shackle, worn as a badge instead of a burden. Equip it in your offhand for a permanent +30 Strength — pure, unfiltered attack power.

name: Emberheart Core
description: A dim coal that flares to life at the edge of death. Equip it in your offhand (+75 Max HP, +10 DEF, +6 STR) — once per battle, when your HP hits 0, it reignites and restores you to 30% HP instead of ending the fight, resetting automatically every battle.

name: Oliver's Goggles
description: Brass-rimmed, wing-hinged, built by hand across a whole story he never told her he was telling. Equip it in your offhand — a permanent +15 Luck, and it always shows you a little more of the map than anyone else can see.

name: Chains of Resurrection
description: Golden links that every god in the world once weighed themselves against. They wrapped a dying boy and pulled him back from the white, link by link, until there was nothing left of the sky to give. Equip them in your offhand for a permanent +25 Intelligence, +25 Defense and +100 Max HP.

name: Second Wind Draught
description: A hard swallow of copper and lightning. Restores 35% of your maximum HP, so it never stops mattering.

name: Warcry Tonic
description: Drink it and your own pulse starts shouting. +20% damage on your next 3 landed hits.

name: Ironskin Draught
description: Your skin goes grey and cold and stops caring. 30% less damage from the next 3 hits you take.

name: Focus Vial
description: Clears the fog behind your eyes. Refills PP on every skill you have spent this match.

name: Cracked Warplate
description: A slab of scavenged plate you hammer over the worst of the damage. Mends half the wear on your most battered armour piece.

name: Honed Whetstone
description: Three passes along the edge and the bite comes back. Mends half the wear on your equipped weapon.

name: Phoenix Clasp
description: A clasp of banked embers worn at the hip. Cancels one death at 40% HP, then slots a fresh Totem of Undying from your PvP kit into your off hand before the ash settles.

name: Steel Helmet
description: Forged steel with a hinged visor. The honest step between iron and diamond.

name: Steel Chestplate
description: Layered steel plate over a padded gambeson. Turns aside what iron only slows.

name: Steel Boots
description: Steel-shod boots with articulated plates. Solid footing without the drag of full iron.

name: Ranger's Boots
description: Light, flexible boots built for scouts who live and die by their footwork.

name: Warlord's Helm
description: A brutal, horned war-helm. Steel enough to trust, heavy enough to swing behind.

name: Bloodrage Draught
description: Drink it and the whole fight narrows to one red line. +40% damage on your next 4 landed hits.

name: Ironwall Draught
description: Your body forgets how to bruise. 40% less damage from the next 4 hits you take.

name: Greater Barrier Tonic
description: A denser weave of the old barrier spell. Absorbs up to 260 damage over 4 turns.

name: Duelist's Sigil
description: A fencer's pin worn at the collar. Equip it in your offhand for a permanent +15 Agility and +10 Luck. You would rather not be hit at all.

name: Revival Stone
description: A dull grey stone, warm on one side. It does not heal wounds and it does not raise the dead - it calls back a companion Yelan has killed, and only that. 50 gems at .revival buy, then .revive <character>.

name: Eternal Draught
description: A small bottle of something that has already decided not to let you sleep. Drink it and the lullaby reaches you and finds no one to put to bed. It lasts until you die, and only until you die.

name: Dawn Tonic
description: Brewed from the first minute of a morning that never came. It goes through you and takes the decay with it. Not sold anywhere. It is found, in the deep places, in the hands of things that do not want to give it up.

name: Revival Drink
description: Warm, bitter, and meant for someone else's mouth. Pour it into a rescued sleeper until they come back. One gives a twitch. Four give you a person.

name: Foglight Blade
description: The blade holds a light that only shows the things standing behind you. It was never forged. It was found, the way the Dreamlands finds things.

name: Lantern Warden Mail
description: Scale lit from the inside by a lantern that went out a long time ago. It keeps the fog about an arm's length away, which is the arm that holds the sword.

name: Sleepwalker's Hood
description: Worn by someone who walked a long way in their sleep. It still smells faintly of a room you have never been in.

name: Drowned Choir Veil
description: Cut from the water the chapel stands in. Hymns gather in it and stay there, humming very quietly, all of them slightly wrong.

name: Hollow Lantern Charm
description: A lantern with nothing inside it that is somehow still lit. It is warm when held and cold when put down.

name: Oath of Fury
description: In dungeons, your attacks deal 15% more damage. Each cleared floor costs 5% of your max HP.

name: Oath of Stone
description: In dungeons, incoming hits deal 15% less damage, but your attacks deal 10% less damage.

name: Oath of Fortune
description: Dungeon monster drop chances are 20 percentage points higher. Dungeon hits deal 10% more damage.

name: Ghostblade
description: Mythic spear. Soul-strike ignores invulnerability and damage immunity. Its Requiem Roster holds twelve names.

name: Astral Witch
description: Seong-ha skin: star-witch robes and a longer cage.

name: Starborn Seraph
description: Seong-ha skin: six wings and the Six Laws.

name: Ha-neul, the Chained Angel
description: Tether summon. Absorbs ally damage as Weight and strikes with it.

name: Starfall Profile Frame
description: Equippable Starfall profile frame.

name: Starfall Banner
description: Equippable Starfall profile banner.

name: Gold Box
description: Mid Solars and mid-tier equipment.

name: Silver Box
description: The best armour and gear in the Starfall pool.

name: Potion Box
description: Mid-tier potions.

name: Uncle Iroh's White Jade Tea
description: Fragrant Jasmine Dragon tea steeped by Uncle Iroh himself. Restores 650 HP and 220 MP.

name: Spirit Oasis Water Vial
description: Sacred glowing water drawn from Tui and La's Northern Spirit Oasis. Fully restores HP and cures all ailments.

name: Sizzling Fire Flakes
description: Fiery Caldera festival snack that stokes inner flame (+45 STR for 4 turns).

name: Monk Gyatso's Fruit Pie
description: Light, flaky Southern Air Temple pastry baked from Monk Gyatso's recipe. Restores 4 Stamina.

name: Bending Mastery Scroll
description: Ancient Four Nations form scroll dropped in homeland sanctums. Grants +450 Affinity Mastery XP to your primary element.

name: Grand Lotus Manual
description: Secret Order of the White Lotus treatise dropped by Four Nations guardians. Grants +1,500 Affinity Mastery XP to your primary element.
